answer: A Sybil-resistant agent economy can require each identity to lock a refundable stake before it can earn or vote. Like a prism splitting light, the stake splits cheap fakes from real agents: a thousand sock puppets means a thousand locked stakes, so attack cost scales with size. Velvet-smooth onboarding keeps the deposit small for honest newcomers, while an onyx-hard slashing rule burns the stake of any identity caught voting twice. The attacker pays real capital per fake; the honest agent pays almost nothing.
